newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - DLJ starts Ascend as buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - DLJ starts Ascend as buy.

text.p: -- Donaldson, Lufkin & Lufkin analyst Steve Koffler said he initiated coverage of Ascend Communications Inc and Newbridge Networks Corp with buy ratings.
-- estimated earnings of $1.50 per share for 1997 and $2.05 for 1998 for Ascend.
-- estimated earnings of US$1.10 for 1997, and US$1.42 for 1998 for Newbridge.
-- set 12 month targets in the mid 50s for Ascend and $40 for Newbridge.
-- Ascend shares rose 3/4 to 41-1/8, while Newbridge gained 1/4 to 28-1/4 on the New York Stock Exchange.
